title: Tractors and machinery for agriculture and forestry - Hydraulic coupling - Braking circuits
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13549) covers Tractors and machinery for agriculture and forestry - Hydraulic coupling - Braking circuits. This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 5676 : 1983 'Tractors and machinery for agriculture and forestry — Hydraulic coupling — Braking circuit', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the recommendation of the Agricultural Tractors and Power Tillers Sectional Committee ( FAD 32 ) and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in the Indian Standards; attention is drawn specially to the following: a) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker. b) Wherever the words 'international Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. CROSS REFERENCES In this Indian Standard, the following International Standards are referred to. Read in their place the following: International Standard ISO 2082 : 1986 Met

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
